decision: One Expo app with file routes under src/app and a single ApiClient
why: BUILD.md already fixed the layout. A second data layer would drift from the contract.

decision: Port deriveTheme from the HTML prototype instead of inventing a new contrast rule
why: The three sample venues already have known ratios.

decision: Payments sandbox refuses to boot without an sk_test_ key
why: A missing secret must not look like a successful charge.
evidence: server/index.mjs exits when the key is absent or not a test key

decision: Each restaurant connects its own Paystack keys instead of split payments
why: Clarke chose it: venues keep full control and Cravins takes no cut

decision: Build the gap-table UI on the mock, then the backend
why: Clarke approved the work; UI first keeps the order of BUILD.md

decision: Two order channels: table QR (no contact data) and menu link (name, phone, address on the order)
why: Pickup and delivery need a way to reach the customer

decision: Plan badge uses the landing placeholder plans; guest pages get dark mode
Delivery distance comes from the customer phone location (with permission), measured straight-line from the venue map pin
why: No outside maps provider or cost; the customer still types the address for the rider
evidence: Clarke picked it over delivery zones and a maps provider
